summary: NIO Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) covering only its monthly and quarterly delivery update. Registrant reported 37,408 September 2026 deliveries, up 7.7% year over year; 109,178 third-quarter units, up 25.4%; and 300,301 first-nine-month deliveries, up 49.2%. Cumulative deliveries reached 1,297,893 as of September 30, 2026. The release also noted NIO All-New ES8 hit 150,000 deliveries since launch and NIO ES9 hit 30,000 since May 28, 2026. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, terms, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
